description: The only way to change a mention. Set status to "ignored" when it is not interesting, "done" when handled, or "open" to reopen it. Assign it with assigneeId, or null to remove the assignment. Hide it from the feed until an ISO 8601 time with snoozedUntil, or null to bring it back. Add a team note with note, or null to remove it. Correct the classifier with `relevant`, where true or false sets relevance to 100 or 0 and moves the mention into or out of the relevant feed, and null removes your judgment. `sentiment` sets the label, and null brings back the classifier's. Use these corrections when the user says a mention is noise or was missed. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Delivery and billing never change.

inputSchema.description: All fields are optional. Fields you leave out stay as they are.

assigneeId.description: The user id of a workspace member, or null to remove the assignment.

note.description: A note for your team. Null or an empty string removes it.

relevant.description: Set it to override the classifier, or null to restore the classifier's score. true means relevance 100, and a filtered mention joins the relevant feed. false means 0, and it leaves. Billing is unaffected. While the mention is still being classified this returns 409 classification_pending.

sentiment.description: The sentiment you choose. Null removes it and brings back the classifier's.

snoozedUntil.description: Hides the mention from the feed until this time, given as ISO 8601 or epoch ms. Send null to bring it back now.

status.description: ignored or done marks it handled, and open reopens it.

name: update_mention
title: Update mention
